title: HOSEA 6:1
THE HEALING BALM
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: gentle morning light on still water
calm river flowing through green valley
soft light through chapel stained glass
tranquil forest river in soft light

scenes.a: If you are sitting alone in the quiet room wondering how your heart survived this week, listen.
scenes.sub: THE LORD BINDS UP OUR WOUNDS

scenes.a: Father, we come to you carrying the deep fractures of our lives, acknowledging our brokenness in your holy presence.
scenes.sub: COME AND RETURN UNTO THE LORD

scenes.a: You are the God who sees every hidden tear and every weary sigh that escapes our lips.
scenes.sub: FOR HE HATH TORN AND WILL HEAL

scenes.a: As your word declares, Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
scenes.sub: HE HATH SMITTEN AND WILL BIND

scenes.a: Lord, where we feel shattered by circumstance, extend your gentle hand to mend what is broken inside.
Pour out your tender mercy upon every heavy spirit seeking solace in you today, O God.
Establish our steps in your unfailing grace, trusting your restoring power through every changing season of life.
In Jesus name we pray, Amen.
